end.parentNote: Saanvi practised spotting square patterns, testing new cases, and using dot or staircase pictures to explain why they work. They correctly connected consecutive triangular numbers such as 6 and 10 to 16, a square number, and described how the shapes fit together. They initially mixed up the general odd-number pattern and later stated that the sequence must start at 1; the teach-back was not completed. At home, ask them to draw two consecutive triangular-number shapes and fit them into a square.
